decisions.reason: Cloud transactional email builds on the firm's core messaging infrastructure and was featured on the home page, so keeping it costs little while demand for cloud email delivery keeps growing.
The managed capture service has its own page and a documented customer reference, which suggests its value is being realized and justifies keeping it rather than abandoning it.

Email and fax conversion uses the firm's existing fax and messaging platform at low marginal cost, and fax still has steady niche demand in German healthcare and business, so the option is worth keeping open.

This feature only adds to the fax service and costs little to maintain, but it was only mentioned on the site and fax is slowly declining, so it carries a moderate risk of being folded into the core offering or dropped.

Sandbox threat protection fits the firm's email security suite and serves a growing market, and unlike the dropped multi-engine scanner it remains on the site, so it is likely a strategic option to keep.
